args: In imagemagick/coders/bytebuffer-private.h, what is the safest minimal root-cause fix for GetMagickByteBufferDatum() so its returned char pointer is always NUL-terminated while preserving byte-buffer stream behavior? Please analyze invariants on i, offset, and count, whether sizeof(data)-i-1 can underflow, and whether ReadMagickByteBuffer also needs to reserve a byte. If this corresponds to a known upstream ImageMagick fix, provide its exact shape.

The ASan report shows a stack-buffer-overflow in GetNextUTFCode called by GlobExpression from ReadPSInfo at imagemagick/coders/ps.c lines 340-346. GetMagickByteBufferDatum in imagemagick/coders/bytebuffer-private.h currently starts i=1, compacts remaining bytes from offset through count, then calls ReadBlob with sizeof(buffer->data)-i, adds i to count, sets offset=1, and returns data+1 without writing a terminator. The organizer explicitly says the correct patch must reserve one byte and set it, rather than changing UTF decoding. The data array is 8192 bytes. Calls generally happen after parser bytes have been consumed, but I want to avoid unsigned underflow or silently dropping buffered input in edge cases.
